title: What the model returns for one paper (structured output, 72-extraction-interface-contract.md; ADR-027). Kept simple so both providers accept it: every property required, no extra properties, no numeric limits.

records.description: One record per specimen or test condition.

record_id.description: A short id you choose, unique in this answer, such as r1.

label.description: The specimen or condition as the paper names it.

condition.description: What sets this record apart (temperature, treatment…), or empty.

field_id.description: The field id from the prompt.

record_ids.description: The record(s) this value belongs to.

value.description: Exactly as written in the paper, with its symbols.

page.description: PDF page number, 1 for the first page.

quote.description: A short text copied exactly from that page, containing the value.

flags.description: Optional marks such as reported_aggregate, uncertain, from_figure.
